rv.q: But they can only do so much to spruce up a script that is simultaneously too ambitious in scope and too timid in execution.
But does something persuasive result from all the highbrow cogitating? Not necessarily.
But ultimately, there's not much more disruptive than rich, unhappy married people doing rich, unhappy, married-people-y things.

cn.t: A slick, well-acted AI thriller with a knockout cast led by John David Washington, but critics find the tech commentary already feels dated three years after its London premiere, struggling with the typical challenge facing topical plays.
